title: Edge Match 64
description: Rotate tiles to match their edges. Start with a warm-up, work through harder puzzles, or choose your own board size.

title: Graph Rescue
description: Identify the slope and y-intercept, plot two points, and draw the flight path. Steer the rescue drone, collect coins, and upgrade it between missions.

title: Metro Line Architect
description: Design realistic transit routes by calculating slope and y-intercept from engineering briefs, maps, points, and station data.

title: NEBULA STRIKE
description: Pilot your interceptor through asteroid waves, build combos, and use hyperspace to escape danger. W or Up to thrust, A/D or Left/Right to rotate, Space to fire, and Shift for hyperspace.

title: Next Chapter
description: Build your first independent life. Explore careers, find a home, plan transportation, and make a budget work in the Dracut / Lowell area.

title: Launch Control: Operation Zero
description: Stabilize a realistic launch sequence by selecting and solving each operation in the correct PEMDAS order.

title: PEMDAS Defuser
description: Select the next correct operation and solve it step by step before the timer runs out. Choose Standard or Hardcore mode.

title: PEMDAS Power Plant
description: Bring a dark city back to life. Select and solve each operation to restore eight districts, with guided practice and a harder challenge mode.

title: PEMDAS Power Run
description: Earn rockets by solving PEMDAS problems. Try four short stages in Quick Mission or all 16 in Full Mission. Watch for red searchlights and attack tells as you cross the Steelworks and Final Reactor.

title: Slope Bird
description: Read tables, ordered pairs, and graphs to unlock 18 gates. Practice domain, range, and the vertical line test, then flap through each opening.

title: Slope-Intercept Laser Defense
description: Use linear equations and slope-intercept form to configure a defensive laser grid.
